prompt: Michael is a new system administrator responsible for setting up Apache2 on a Debian-based system. He knows that there's a specific directory where additional configuration files can be placed to be loaded by Apache2 automatically. Which directory is this?
explanation: On Debian-based systems, Apache2 has a structure wherein configuration files placed in the /etc/apache2/conf-enabled/ directory are loaded automatically by Apache. It allows administrators to keep the main configuration file uncluttered and manage additional configurations separately.
